status.browseLaunch: Browse this directory · {{shortcut}} — the one this session started in
status.collisionTitle: {{collision}}. Two tabs changing one file diverge until one of them rebases.
status.clicksHint: Let the agent's own prompts, subagents and running shells answer the mouse; the rails then come from its transcript. Needs its fullscreen renderer. Switching reopens the conversation with continue.
status.scrollbackHint: Keep the terminal's own history, which the find bar, the path beside the scrollbar and the width repair all read. The agent takes no clicks. Switching reopens the conversation with continue.

sync.noUpstream: This branch has no upstream to pull from
